notes: four routes: three meet at «كلهم عن هشام بن عروة» and the fourth (the «وحدثنا أبو كريب» route) reaches Hisham by its own text; the rest of the chain (his father, Abd Allah b. Ja'far, Ali) is read as the shared tail
«واللفظ، حديث أبي أسامة» (wording) and «أشار وكيع إلى السماء والأرض» (a gesture) are left out
reading flagged for the tail: the fourth route writes its names after the last «ح», so the tail is the one place the text states once
